pathParams.description: Pass the object type to lookup. For the list of supported object types, see **Supported SDO Types** in **Threat Data** > **Miscellaneous**.

queryParams.name: enrichment_data
queryParams.description: Pass true to retrieve the latest five enrichment data objects.

queryParams.name: relation_data
queryParams.description: Pass true to retrieve the latest 100 relations details.

queryParams.name: enrichment_tools
queryParams.description: Pass the name of up to five enrichment tools separated by a comma. To retrieve a list of enrichment tools, use the **GET Enrichment Tools API** under **Administration** > **Enrichment Management** > **Enrichment Tools**.

queryParams.name: fields
queryParams.description: Pass a comma-separated list of field names to retrieve specific details of the objects. By default, all fields are retrieved.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve details from.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of records to be retrieved per page.

endpoints.name: Get Threat Data Object Preview
endpoints.description: Retrieves specific details of a threat data object.

pathParams.name: object_type
pathParams.description: Pass the type of threat data objects. To get the list of supported object types, see **Supported SDO Types** in **Threat Data** > **Miscellaneous** > **List IOC Types**.

pathParams.name: object_id
pathParams.description: Pass the list of threat data object IDs to perform the bulk action. To retrieve a list of object IDs, use the **List Threat Data API** under the Threat Data section.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

endpoints.name: Get IOC Types List
endpoints.description: Retrieves all the valid IOC types in Intel Exchange.

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Pass a keyword to narrow search results.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

endpoints.name: Get Countries List
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of a list of countries.

queryParams.name: full_list
queryParams.description: Pass true to disable pagination and retrieve the details of all countries.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve country details.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of countries to retrieve on each page.

queryParams.name: query
queryParams.description: Pass a keyword to narrow the search.

endpoints.name: Get Source Types List
endpoints.description: Returns the types of feed sources available in Intel Exchange.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

endpoints.name: Get Sources List
endpoints.description: Returns a list of feed sources from Intel Exchange

queryParams.name: source_type
queryParams.description: Pass a comma-seperated list of the source type IDs to filter sources based on the type. You can retrieve the ID using the **List Source Types API**.

queryParams.name: nominal
queryParams.description: Pass true to apply the CQL query.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve sources.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of sources to be retrieved on each page.

endpoints.name: Get Saved Searches List
endpoints.description: Lists the threat data queries that are saved by the user.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the results from.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of saved search records to be retrieved in each page.

queryParams.name: query
queryParams.description: Pass a keyword to narrow the search. Example, *malware*.

endpoints.name: Get Saved Search Details
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of a saved search.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Pass the unique ID of a saved search. You can retrieve the ID using the **List Saved Searches API**. Example, *7f3a7db2-a042-4989-90bc-cd175b2fa9e1*.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

endpoints.name: Create Saved Search
endpoints.description: Creates a saved search in Intel Exchange.

endpoints.name: Update Saved Search
endpoints.description: Updates the saved search data in Intel Exchange.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Pass the unique ID of a saved search to be update. You can retrieve the ID using the **List Saved Searches API**. Example, *1a7d5c8a-848a-4a67-af82-e68f3d823c65*.

endpoints.name: Delete Saved Search
endpoints.description: Deletes a saved search.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Pass the unique ID of a saved search. You can retrieve the ID using the **List Saved Searches API**. Example, *dd545fe7-1f15-4938-b658-21b29be3698f*.

endpoints.name: Pin Saved Search
endpoints.description: Pins a saved search in Intel Exchange.

endpoints.name: Remove Pined Saved Search
endpoints.description: Removes a saved search from the pinned search list.

endpoints.name: Update Pinned Saved Search
endpoints.description: Updates the order of a pinned saved search in Intel Exchange.

endpoints.name: AI-Assisted Search
endpoints.description:
Converts a natural language prompt into an Intel Exchange search query. ### Changelog

Added a new endpoint for AI-assisted search in Threat Data.
